name: France

observations.reasoning: Sourced on 2026-07-27, transversal pass over the population indicator. Population on 1 January 2025: 68882600 inhabitants, recorded as 68.883 million. Eurostat dataset demo_pjan, Population on 1 January by age and sex, read through the dissemination API on 2026-07-27, dataset last updated 2026-07-09. Total population, both sexes, all ages, which is exactly what this indicator's denominator asks for. Read as one table covering every country in the record, so no value here is derived from a neighbour: each is that country's own row. The previous value was an opening estimate produced with no source and no research.

Read on 2026-07-27 from the Ministry of Culture's own page for the Centre national de la marionnette label, created by decree on 4 November 2021. Seven structures carry it, each with its postal address on the page: L'Espace Jéliote, Oloron-Sainte-Marie; L'Hectare-Territoires vendômois, Vendôme; Le Mouffetard – Théâtre des arts de la marionnette, 73 rue Mouffetard, Paris; Le Théâtre à la Coque, Hennebont; Le Théâtre de Laval; Le Sablier, which is one structure on two sites at Ifs and Dives-sur-Mer; Le Tas de Sable – Ches Panses Vertes, Rivery. All seven are freestanding organisations, hence seven house and no stage. The page's own text says seven and adds that about ten are expected in the medium term. This is a floor and the map should not be read as though it were a ceiling, which is why the record is disputed. The label is one route to public backing, not the definition of it, and the denominator asks only for a permanent puppetry unit with a venue and a public authority behind it. At least two kinds of French venue meet that and carry no CNMa: the TJP in Strasbourg, a centre dramatique national whose stated vocation is the arts de la marionnette, and the scènes conventionnées d'intérêt national carrying the mention art et création for puppetry, of which Marionnettissimo at Tournefeuille is one. Neither was verified today — the TJP site answered 503 — and neither is counted, because a venue named from memory is not a venue read. The opening estimate was 12 to 15, and it may well prove closer to the truth than this 7. That is not an argument for keeping it: it was produced with no source, and its note listed as CNMa two structures that do not hold the label, Théâtre Jean Arp and Le Bouffou. The seven here can be audited. The estimate could only be believed.

observations.reasoning: Web check of 2026-07-27, resuming the point left open by the previous pass, now settled. One establishment retained: ESNAM Margareta Niculescu, Charleville-Mezieres, within the International Institute of Puppetry. Criteria read at source: a three-year course awarding the DNSPC with the puppeteer-actor specialism, registered at RNCP level 6, the school being accredited by the Ministry of Culture. The previous pass left the upper bound at 2, unable to settle what became of the DMA in puppetry arts after the 2019 reform of that qualification. That candidate is now eliminated: the directory entry still titled DMA in puppetry arts in fact describes ESNAM's own course, a national qualification at RNCP level 6, three years, entry by competition. The DMA title is a stale directory identifier, not a second course. The upper bound therefore comes back to 1. The Institute's page further states that ESNAM is the only school in France given over entirely to initial puppetry training since 1987, a claim this time read at source rather than glimpsed in a search summary. The URCA master's in Circus and Puppetry and the bachelor's in Arts with a puppetry pathway remain excluded as before: the first is not specialised, the second is tied to the ESNAM entrance examination and is not a distinct school. The network blocking that prevented any source being read in the previous pass no longer applies. Status moved from disputed to verified.

observations.reasoning: DISPUTED. First value produced as a mean conditioned on artists who actually tour, which drops from the denominator the makers who do not perform. Method error identified: a fee is not a performance. For France the true median probably sits between 10 and 20, over a bimodal distribution. For countries with permanent companies, recomputed from the top: 250 to 400 performances a year, casts of 3 to 5, a company of about twenty, so on the order of 50 to 90. To be redone in full once the denominator is settled.

venues: 7 is the national label only and is a floor. Sweep the scènes conventionnées d'intérêt national for the mention art et création in puppetry, and settle the TJP Strasbourg, a CDN whose vocation is the arts de la marionnette. Both routes are published by the ministry and by ARTCENA.
